messages.seed_desc:
The last but important step. I have 6 words for you — I'll give them. You need to store them somewhere — I won't give you a place to store them. These words + name are *the only way* to restore access to your VPN.

Hide these words where you can reach them in any situation, but where they can't be found by unwanted parties. Better in a password manager or some other clever place.
